description: Pinned -Wuninitialized / -Wmaybe-uninitialized baseline across all compiled SUEWS Fortran units; see scripts/lint/check_fortran_uninit.py. Entries may only be removed.

entries.reason: Verified GCC 14.2.0 -Wmaybe-uninitialized false positive in untouched vendored ecmwf/spartacus-surface (gh#2172): outer loop guards jn >= ll and jn/ll are invariant until exit, so do ji = ll, jn always executes at least once and assigns lb = jn + ll - ji before any read.
